item.text: Before your operation
Module
About you
Your name
Your date of birth
Your sex
Your Medicare number
Best phone number to reach you
Your home address
The language you prefer to speak
Do you need an interpreter?
Your health
Has a doctor ever told you that you have low iron or anaemia (a low blood count)?
Have you taken iron tablets or iron liquid in the last year?
Have you ever had an iron drip (iron infusion)?
In the last month, have you felt more tired or short of breath than usual?
Do you bruise easily, or bleed for a long time after a small cut?
Have you noticed blood in your poo, black poo, or vomited blood?
Do you have heavy periods?
Do you take any medicine that thins your blood? (for example warfarin, apixaban (Eliquis), rivaroxaban (Xarelto), clopidogrel or aspirin)
Which ones?
Has a doctor told you that you have kidney problems?
Food and diet
Which best describes how you eat?
Do you usually drink tea or coffee with your meals?
Have you lost your appetite or lost weight without trying in the last 3 months?
Blood transfusion
Have you ever had a blood transfusion?
If you needed a blood transfusion during or after your operation, would you accept it?
Which of these would you accept? Tick all that apply.
